name: cable standing biceps curl to arnold press v. 3
description: A combo of a biceps curl flowing into an Arnold press with cables. It works arms and shoulders in one fluid move.
instructions: Hold low cable handles, palms forward, arms down.
Curl the handles up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms inward as you start to press.
Press overhead, turning your palms forward.
Reverse the move and lower under control.
